description: Dark blue circle at the top of the paper. A lighter blue, curvy line extends from the circle towards the bottom of the paper, ending in a point. Dark blue stroke is to the left of the curvy line with a small  blue dot between the stroke and the curvy line. A blue dot is to the right of the blue circle at the top of the paper.
